主要内容: On January 5, 2018, Kevin D. Bates resigned from the Board of Directors of Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NICHOLAS) to focus on his role as Senior Vice President – Branch Operations. His resignation enabled Douglas Marohn, the Company’s President and CEO, to join the Board in compliance with NASDAQ director independence standards. On the same date, the Board elected Mr. Marohn to fill the vacancy left by Mr. Bates, effective January 8, 2018. The report includes forward-looking statements regarding the Company’s future expectations, which involve risks and uncertainties and may differ from projections. The filing updates any forward-looking statements. Prospective investors are advised to consult the risks described in the Company's Reports on Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K, as well as Annual Reports to Shareholders. The report was signed by Katie L. MacGillivary, Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NICHOLAS FINANCIAL, INC., on January 9, 2018, in accordance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
